sql: SELECT l.id, l.amount, r.label FROM events_left l JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT l.id, r.amount FROM events_left l LEFT JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT label, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events_left GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS decimal_amount FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CASE WHEN id = 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE amount END AS maybe_amount FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM events_left
SELECT DISTINCT label FROM events_left ORDER BY label
SELECT id, amount FROM events_left WHERE amount >= 20 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM events_left WHERE id IN (1, 3) ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM events_left WHERE amount BETWEEN 10 AND 30 ORDER BY id
SELECT label, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events_left GROUP BY label HAVING SUM(amount) >= 20 ORDER BY label
SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS total FROM events_left GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT label, AVG(amount) AS average FROM events_left GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT id FROM events_left UNION ALL SELECT id FROM events_right ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM events_left UNION SELECT id FROM events_right ORDER BY id
SELECT l.id AS left_id, r.id AS right_id FROM events_left l RIGHT JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY r.id
SELECT l.id AS left_id, r.id AS right_id FROM events_left l FULL JOIN events_right r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY COALESCE(l.id, r.id)
SELECT l.id FROM events_left l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_right r WHERE r.id = l.id) ORDER BY l.id
SELECT l.id FROM events_left l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_right r WHERE r.id = l.id) ORDER BY l.id
SELECT id, CASE WHEN amount > 20 THEN 'large' ELSE 'small' END AS size FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, COALESCE(label, 'unknown') AS name FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, NULLIF(amount, 20) AS amount FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, UPPER(label) AS uppercase FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUBSTRING(label, 1, 2) AS prefix FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM events_left WHERE label LIKE '%a%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS INT) AS rank FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS previous FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS next_value FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY (id % 2)) AS bucket_sum FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS day FROM events_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS plus_one FROM events_left ORDER BY id
